subject: API rate limit hit unexpectedly
body: We hit the API rate limit today despite not changing our polling frequency. Had to pause our integration for a few hours. Could you check if the limit changed recently?

subject: Connector sync stuck
body: Our main connector has been stuck 'syncing' for over six hours with no data coming through. Following the rate-limit surprise last week, this is the second odd thing in a fortnight.

subject: Exports failing since the connector fix
body: Since the connector issue from February got sorted, exports have started failing instead - eleven days now without a working scheduled export. Feels like whack-a-mole at this point.

subject: Alerts wrong for two weeks
body: Our alerts have been firing on stale data for what looks like two weeks. Between this and the export problem in June, I'm struggling to trust the numbers we're getting.

subject: Alerts broken again - fourteen days to fix last time
body: Same alert issue as August, and it took two weeks to sort last time. Please tell me this one moves faster.

subject: Dashboard showing wrong totals
body: Our summary dashboard is showing totals that don't match the underlying report. Fifth issue this year and each one chips away at confidence in the platform.

subject: Escalating - API unreliable for a year now
body: I'd like this escalated properly. Going back to February, we've had API problems, connector problems, export problems, alert problems twice, and a dashboard problem - almost one a month. We need a real fix, not another ticket.

subject: Dashboard issue while waiting on escalation
body: Another dashboard glitch while we wait to hear back on the escalation from two days ago. Numbers off by roughly 10% on the operations view.

subject: Still waiting - third dashboard issue this month
body: Third dashboard problem in January alone. We haven't had a substantive response to the escalation yet either.

subject: Exports stable, thanks
body: Wanted to note that exports have been solid for a few months now since the escalation call. Small ask: can we get a warning email before a scheduled export silently skips due to no new data?

subject: Dashboard consistency check
body: Dashboards have matched the underlying reports consistently since the changes went in. Appreciate the follow-through this time.

subject: API stability check-in
body: No rate-limit surprises or failures on the API side in months now. Is there a status page we can bookmark instead of guessing when something's off?

subject: Minor export cosmetic issue
body: Tiny thing - the export filename still uses the old date format (DDMMYYYY) rather than ISO. Not urgent, just noting it while things are otherwise running well.

subject: Dashboard tile request
body: Given how stable things have been, would it be worth adding a tile type for cumulative year-to-date totals? Would save us a manual report each month.

subject: Export automation question
body: Can a scheduled export trigger a webhook once complete, so we can automate the next step in our pipeline?

subject: New connector for logistics data
body: Looking to add a connector for our logistics partner's data feed. Is there a standard one, or would this be a custom build?

subject: Connector permissions question
body: Can a specific connector be restricted to only certain users, or do all admins see all connectors by default?

subject: API documentation update
body: Noticed the API docs for the exports endpoint are a version behind what's actually live. Not blocking us, just flagging it.

subject: Seat renewal question
body: Ahead of our renewal, could you send a current breakdown of seat usage by department? Trying to right-size before the next contract period.

subject: Connector sync failing — authentication error
body:
Our HubSpot connector started throwing authentication errors this morning, syncs are failing. Credentials haven't changed. Can you check if there's something on your side?

Tero Lindqvist

subject: Connector sync schedule — not running at configured time
body:
Our data connector is set to sync at 06:00 but it's been running anywhere between 06:00 and 08:30 over the past week. We rely on the data being fresh for our morning reports. Is there a queueing issue?

Tero Lindqvist

subject: API — filter parameter not working as documented
body:
The `filter[date_range]` parameter in the reports endpoint doesn't seem to respect the end date boundary — results include records from the following day. Per the docs, the range should be inclusive. Please advise.

Tero Lindqvist

subject: Connector failing silently again — no error notifications
body:
Our connector has been failing since Wednesday and we only found out because the dashboards were showing stale data. There were no error notifications sent despite alerts being configured. This isn't the first time this has happened. The lack of visibility is making it difficult to trust the platform for operational reporting. Please look into both the connector failure and why alerts didn't fire.

Tero Lindqvist
Head of Operations

subject: Report builder — calculated fields giving wrong results
body:
A calculated field using a percentage formula is returning incorrect values when the denominator is zero — it should return null or 0 but instead shows garbage. Reports are going out to management with wrong numbers in them. This needs to be fixed urgently.

Tero Lindqvist

subject: API breaking changes — no advance notice
body:
Our integration broke last week due to a change in the API response format — a field was renamed without any deprecation notice or changelog entry. We lost two days of pipeline output before we found the cause. We need proper advance notice for breaking changes. What is your API versioning policy?

Tero Lindqvist

subject: Report scheduler broken — AGAIN
body:
Report scheduler is not sending scheduled reports. This is the third distinct issue with report delivery this quarter. Reports just don't arrive, no error in the UI, nothing in the log I can access. My team has stopped relying on scheduled delivery and is exporting manually every morning.

Tero Lindqvist

subject: API returning 500 on /metrics endpoint
body:
Getting consistent 500 errors from the /metrics endpoint since yesterday afternoon. Nothing changed on our side. This is blocking our daily data pull entirely.

Tero Lindqvist

subject: Report builder — formatting lost on save
body:
Column formatting in saved reports keeps reverting. Every time we open a saved report, number formatting on currency columns is gone. We've reported formatting bugs before and each fix seems to introduce a new one. Honestly getting tired of the quality of this module.

Tero Lindqvist

subject: API key permissions — read-only key has write access
body:
Read-only API key appears to have write permissions it shouldn't. Please check and correct.

Tero Lindqvist

subject: API response latency — degraded for two days
body:
API response times have been significantly higher than usual since Monday. P95 is around 4s, was previously under 800ms. Not blocking us but worth flagging.

Tero Lindqvist

subject: Removing deactivated user — seat still counted
body:
We deactivated a user three weeks ago but the seat is still showing as occupied and counting toward our limit. Can this be corrected?

Tero Lindqvist

subject: Alert recipient groups - question
body: Can alert recipient groups be nested, so that a change to a department's group membership automatically updates who receives the relevant alerts, rather than us maintaining a separate list per alert? Trying to reduce the admin overhead of keeping alert subscriptions in sync with our org chart as the team grows.

subject: Connector sync failures - no clear pattern
body: Our warehouse connector has failed intermittently over the past couple of weeks, sometimes syncing fine for days and then failing twice in one morning, without any consistent error message we can point to. We've started cross-checking the numbers manually when something looks off, which has become part of our routine now. Separately, we had a look at Dashlume this month as part of a general review of reporting tools, mainly prompted by wanting more visibility into sync reliability generally.

subject: Export issues on top of the connector problems
body: On top of the connector sync issues from October, our scheduled exports have also started arriving with outdated figures roughly once a week, presumably tied to the same underlying reliability question. We've adjusted our process so someone spot-checks each export against the live dashboard before it goes out, which takes a few extra minutes but catches the problem when it happens. Still keeping half an eye on Dashlume as part of our review, though nothing decided yet. No urgency on our end for now.

subject: Seat allocation for new department
body: We're standing up a small analytics function and need to add four seats under a new department grouping. Is that something we set up ourselves or does it need your side?

subject: Seat grouping - follow-up
body: Following up on the department grouping from last week - it's set up now but the new group isn't showing in the usage report. Expected lag, or a bug?

subject: Dashboard for new department
body: Now that the new analytics group has seats, could you point us to how to set up a dedicated dashboard just for them?

subject: API pagination
body: What's the default page size for the reports list endpoint, and is it configurable? Want to make sure our integration handles pagination correctly.

subject: API access for finance team
body: Could you provision API credentials for two more members of the finance team? They'll need read access to the reports endpoint only.

subject: Alert digest option
body: Is there a daily digest option for alerts, rather than each one arriving as a separate email? We're getting quite a few now.

subject: Export access for auditors
body: Our external auditors will need to pull a few specific exports during the audit window. What's the cleanest way to grant temporary access without a full seat?

subject: API integration question over the holidays
body: Setting up a new integration during the quiet period between Christmas and New Year - is there a sandbox environment we can test API calls against before going live?

subject: Follow-up on sandbox access
body: Thanks for the sandbox details. One more thing - do sandbox API calls count against our production rate limit, or are they tracked separately?

subject: Report builder - operations template
body: Looking to build a standard operations report with shift-level granularity. Is there an existing template we could start from rather than building from scratch?

subject: SSO setup — attribute mapping question
body:
We're configuring SSO via SAML and I need to confirm the expected attribute name for the user's email in the SAML assertion. We're currently using `emailAddress` but getting errors on login. Should it be `email` or `http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/ws/2005/05/identity/claims/emailaddress`?

Hanna Lindqvist
Senior Analyst

subject: Export template — decimal separator locale
body:
Exported CSV files are using a period as the decimal separator. Our finance team's systems expect a comma (European locale). Is there a locale setting for export formatting or do we need to handle this conversion ourselves?

Hanna Lindqvist

subject: User role — can't assign custom role to new user
body:
When inviting a new user I can only assign default roles (Viewer, Editor, Admin). We have a custom role configured but it doesn't appear in the invite flow dropdown. Is there a step I'm missing, or does the user need to be created first before the custom role can be applied?

Hanna Lindqvist

subject: Audit log — export not available for our plan?
body:
We're trying to pull the admin audit log for a compliance review. The documentation says audit log export is available on Professional plans, which is what we're on. However the export button is grayed out in the UI with no explanation. Could you check whether this is enabled for our account?

Hanna Lindqvist

subject: Bulk export job stuck in queued state
body:
A large export job has been in "Queued" state for over 18 hours. There's no error and no progress. The job is for approximately 200k rows. Is there a size or timeout limit on bulk exports? We've had to cancel it twice now.

Hanna Lindqvist

subject: Alert — notification channel deleted but still referenced
body:
We deleted a Slack notification channel from the system and configured a replacement, but existing alerts still reference the old channel (which no longer exists). The alerts show as active but notifications aren't arriving. There's no way to bulk-update the channel across all alerts — I have to edit each one individually. With 40+ alerts configured this is a significant effort. Is there a bulk update option or can support help with this?

Hanna Lindqvist

subject: Connector setup went smoothly
body: Just wanted to say the new warehouse connector setup was painless, support talked us through it in one call. One small question: can sync frequency be changed later without reconfiguring the whole connector?

subject: Report builder - really pleased with the flexibility
body: We've rebuilt most of our monthly reporting in the new report builder and it's saved us real time. Is there a way to version report templates so we can roll back if a change doesn't work out?

subject: Feature request: connector for our new POS system
body: We've switched POS providers and would love a native connector rather than the generic CSV route we're using elsewhere. Is a connector for Shopify POS on the roadmap at all?

subject: Feature request: export directly to Google Sheets
body: Would it be possible to add a direct export-to-Google-Sheets option? We currently download CSVs and re-upload manually, which is the one clunky step left in our workflow.

subject: Adding two seats for new hires
body: Two new analysts starting next month, could you add the seats to our account? Everything's been working really well for us, easy request.

subject: Alert thresholds not firing
body: Our threshold alerts on the weekly revenue dashboard haven't fired in over a week even though the numbers clearly crossed the limit. Can someone check the alert configuration for our account? This is the second week we've missed a flag we rely on.

subject: Report builder keeps reverting formatting
body: Every time we save a custom report, the column widths and grouping reset the next time we open it. We've had to redo the layout four times now. Can you look into this?

subject: Still losing report sections - third issue since May
body: This is the third report builder problem since May. Now saved layouts are losing whole sections when reopened, no warning, no error. We've stopped trusting the tool for anything client-facing. Please escalate this properly instead of the usual back and forth.

subject: Dashboard widgets showing stale data
body: Two months of formatting bugs and now the executive dashboard is showing last week's numbers as current. Whoever reviews these tickets needs to understand this is customer-facing for us.

subject: Connector to our ERP dropped - please escalate
body: The nightly sync to our ERP system has failed silently for the past four days; nobody flagged it from your side, we noticed because the numbers stopped moving. Given the year we've had with this account, I'm asking for this to go to someone senior, not the queue.

subject: Alerts down again - following up on March escalation
body: Separate from the connector issue from March, our alert notifications have stopped sending entirely since Monday. I raised that as an escalation last time and I'd like a named contact this time, not another ticket number.

subject: Connector issue from March - actually fixed
body: Following up properly on the ERP connector problem from March: the fix has held for two weeks now and the sync log finally looks normal. Appreciate someone actually walking us through what changed.

subject: API rate limit question
body: Quick one - we're hitting rate limits on the reporting API during month-end pulls. Can you confirm the limit for our plan and whether it can be raised?

subject: Adding two new seats
body: We're bringing two new analysts onto the platform - could you add the seats under our Professional plan? Happy to confirm billing separately.

subject: Report builder - nested grouping question
body: Trying to group a report by region then by product without the totals collapsing. Is there a guide for nested grouping, or could support point me to the right setting?

subject: Dashboard sharing link expired
body: The shared read-only dashboard link for our board pack has expired. Could you reissue it or point me to where we manage link expiry ourselves?

subject: Alert recipient list out of date
body: One of our alert rules is still emailing a colleague who left in the summer. Could you help us update the recipient list, or is that something we can self-serve?

subject: Second alert question - daily digest timing
body: Separate from the recipient list issue I just sent - is there a way to change the daily digest send time? Ours arrives at 6am local, before the overnight batch finishes.

subject: New connector for our warehouse system
body: We've moved part of our data warehouse to a new provider. Could you confirm whether Kataja has a native connector for it, or if we'll need the generic API route?

subject: Dashboard — chart type options
body:
We're setting up our first dashboard and I have a question about chart types. Is there a way to display a waterfall chart, or is the library limited to bar, line, and pie? Looking to visualize budget variance.

Mikael Nordgren
IT Manager

subject: API token rotation question
body: We rotate our API keys quarterly for security compliance - can you confirm the process for updating the key on our end without breaking scheduled pulls?

subject: Connector setup for new accounting system
body: We're migrating our accounting data source and need to set up a new connector alongside the existing one during the transition. Could someone confirm supported source systems for this?

subject: API pagination limit
body: Pulling larger datasets via the API and running into pagination limits sooner than expected. Is there documentation on the current page size caps?

subject: Conditional formatting in report builder
body: Trying to set up conditional formatting so cells turn red below a threshold in a shared report. Can you point me to the setting, or is this not yet supported?

subject: Dashboard filter defaults reset
body: When colleagues open our shared dashboard the date filter resets to 'last 7 days' instead of the default we set. Is there a way to lock the default filter for all viewers?

subject: API broken during month-end close AGAIN
body: API calls for our month-end reporting job are timing out. We are literally in close week. Need eyes on this now, not tomorrow.

subject: Report builder crashing on save
body: Now report builder throws an error every time we save the close-week template. Two issues in two days during our busiest week of the month - not great timing.

subject: API still not stable
body: Yesterday's API fix didn't hold - calls are intermittent again this morning. Please confirm whether this is actually fixed before I tell my team to rely on it.

subject: Dashboard totals don't match report builder
body: Dashboard is showing different totals than the report we just fixed. Which number is right? Can't send either to the board like this.

subject: Export to Excel corrupting file
body: The export we need for the board pack comes out as a corrupted xlsx file. Fifth issue this week - I know it's close week and things break, but please get someone senior on this thread. Appreciate the quick turnarounds so far, still, five in a week is a lot.

subject: Dashboard widget frozen on load
body: One widget on the main ops dashboard has been frozen since this morning, spinning with no data. Not urgent like close week but still needs fixing today please.

subject: API authentication failing since this morning
body: Every scheduled API pull failed overnight - getting 401 errors across the board. Nothing changed on our end. Please check if something changed on yours.

subject: API down on first working day of the year
body: First day back and the API integration is throwing errors on every call. Great start to the year. Need this fixed today, we have year-end reports due.

subject: Can't add new starter to the account
body: Trying to add our new analyst as a seat and the invite keeps bouncing. On top of the API issue this morning, today has been a write-off. Please just fix the seat invite.

subject: Seat invite still not working
body: Yesterday's fix for the seat invite didn't take - same bounce error. Second day running on one small thing.

subject: API errors back again
body: The API is erroring again, same symptoms as Thursday. Please check whatever was 'fixed' actually held this time.

subject: Export button doing nothing
body: Export to PDF just spins and never downloads. Fourth thing this week between API and seats. Appreciate the fast turnarounds each time, but it's a lot of tickets for one week.

subject: Seat count wrong on invoice
body: Our invoice shows two more seats than we actually have active. Please correct this before it renews - we've flagged seat/billing mismatches before.

subject: Dashboard not loading for half our team
body: Several colleagues can't get dashboards to load past a spinning icon while others are fine. Cleared cache, tried different browsers, still happening. Can you look into this properly rather than the usual 'try incognito' reply?

subject: Alerts silent since the dashboard issue
body: Separate to the dashboard loading problem still open, our alert emails have stopped arriving entirely for the past week. Two things broken at once isn't inspiring confidence right now.

subject: API broken, dashboard issue still open two months later
body: The dashboard loading issue from November is still not resolved, and now our API integration is throwing 500 errors. I'd like an update on the older ticket as well as help with this new one.

subject: Dashboard issue from November - still not fixed
body: It has been over four months since I first reported dashboards failing to load for part of our team. It is still happening. I need a real answer, not another troubleshooting script.

subject: Escalating - dashboard loading, four months unresolved
body: I'm formally escalating the dashboard loading fault first reported in November. This has gone on far too long for a fault affecting half our users daily. Please get someone from engineering on this, not tier one support.

subject: Report builder also broken now
body: While the dashboard escalation is still being worked, report builder has started throwing save errors too. I don't say this lightly: we are close to reviewing whether this platform is still fit for our team.

subject: Dashboard fix - finally confirmed working
body: Wanted to follow up properly: the dashboard loading issue from last winter has been stable for three weeks now across the whole team. Thank you to whoever finally traced the root cause - that was a long road.

subject: One dashboard widget still slow to refresh
body: Minor compared to the earlier issue, but one specific widget on the sales dashboard is slower to refresh than the rest. Flagging in case it's related to the earlier fix.

subject: Thanks - and a small dashboard question
body: Things have been noticeably smoother since the summer fix. Quick question: can we clone a dashboard layout across two teams without rebuilding from scratch?

subject: Report builder - scheduled delivery question

subject: Follow-up - scheduling to external addresses

body: We're building a small internal tool against your reporting API. Is there an up-to-date reference for the endpoints beyond what's in the developer portal?

subject: Alert rule sending duplicate notifications

subject: Report builder template sharing

subject: Alert delivery delay

subject: Report builder - currency formatting

subject: Feature request: webhook support

subject: Feature request: version history for reports

subject: Feature request: incremental sync option
body: Currently our connector does a full resync each time - could an incremental sync mode be added for larger tables? Would cut our sync time a lot.
